subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Moving Company Hostage Scams
description: A fast breakdown of Moving Company Hostage Scams for builders.

hook.text: A moving company loads your belongings, then triples the price. Pay up or your stuff is gone.

buildup.text: Rogue movers give low estimates, load everything onto the truck, then demand far more.

discovery.text: Your furniture is held hostage in a storage unit until you pay the inflated fee.

twist.text: The FMCSA receives thousands of moving fraud complaints yearly, but most victims just pay.

climax.text: Legitimate movers provide binding estimates and are registered with the FMCSA.

punchline.text: They moved your stuff. Then they moved the price.

quiz.question: What is a moving company hostage scam?
options: Movers inflate the price after loading your belongings
Movers deliver to the wrong address
